journey.name: Select Story Item Details
journey.description: Verifies that a user can find and tap a specific app story (such as Xperiencia) from the feed and view its detailed sections (Origin Story, Growth Playbook, store links).

actions.action: Verify that the app is on the "Discover" feed
Scroll until the app story "Xperiencia" is visible
Verify that the story detail screen opens with title "Xperiencia"
Verify that the "Store Description" section is visible
Scroll down until the "✏️ Suggest Edits" button is visible
Verify that the "✏️ Suggest Edits" button is visible
Verify that the app returns to the "Discover" feed
